profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: I'm a 28 year old Software Engineer with a degree in Computer Science and Technology Engineering. Ever since I got an active interest in computer science, I've focused on honing my programming and software development skills by learning new programming languages (Java, C++, Ruby, JavaScript/TypeScript), working with a variety of different development frameworks (Ruby on Rails, React.js, Node.js) and technologies (Docker, Git) and participating in numerous hackathons and coding competitions. I have experience in both software engineering as well as training and management of software engineers.
